items.title: Announcing AWS SDK for .NET 4.1
items.summary: In July 2026, we announced our annual minor release cycle for updating the AWS SDK for .NET build targets. Today we’re releasing 4.1, the first release on this schedule. Along with the build target changes, we made dependency changes that improve performance and make the SDK easier to use. If your project targets a version […]
